answer_2.quote: We use Accuracy for tasks that require a discrete output (e.g., an entity); Exact Match (EM) for tasks with extractive (i.e., Natural Questions, TriviaQA) or short abstractive output format (i.e., HotpotQA); finally, for tasks with long abstractive output format, we use ROUGE-L for ELI5 and F1-score for Wizard of Wikipedia.
